acceptance: Each of the 17 entries is fixed or has a recorded reason to stay; a sampled live check of edit links runs periodically or the exclusion is accepted in writing.
description: The nightly published-documentation crawl accepts 17 failures listed in inventory/known-broken-links.json (662,876 links checked on 2026-10-27). It also excludes the generated edit links (about 1,700 distinct GitHub URLs) because they trip GitHub's rate limit; their derivation has unit tests but the live targets are not crawled.
